import type {
  Command,
  CommandErrorOptions,
  DefaultConfig,
  ExitResult,
  OptionalConfig,
  RequiredConfig,
  RunConfig,
  RunResult,
} from '@argvia/core'
import { CommandError, defineCommand, exit, option, run } from '@argvia/core'
// @ts-expect-error 核心入口不导出进程适配器
import { runMain } from '@argvia/core'

function expectType<Value>(value: Value): void {
  void value
}

interface ProjectConfig {
  includeTests?: boolean
  retries?: number
}

interface FinalConfig {
  includeTests: boolean
  retries: number
}

const optional: OptionalConfig = { description: '配置合并时保留缺省状态' }
const defaultFalse: DefaultConfig<boolean> = { default: false }
const required: RequiredConfig = { required: true }
const config: ProjectConfig = { includeTests: true, retries: 4 }

const command: Command = defineCommand({
  passthrough: true,
  options: {
    includeTests: option.boolean(optional),
    force: option.boolean(defaultFalse),
    retries: option.number(),
    target: option.string({ ...required, flag: '--entry' }),
    items: option.string({ flag: '--item', multiple: true }),
  },
  run({ options, passthrough }) {
    expectType<readonly string[]>(passthrough)
    // @ts-expect-error 透传上下文按只读数组提供
    passthrough.push('value')
    expectType<boolean | undefined>(options.includeTests)
    expectType<boolean>(options.force)
    expectType<number | undefined>(options.retries)
    expectType<string>(options.target)
    expectType<string[]>(options.items)
    // @ts-expect-error 重复字符串得到数组
    expectType<string>(options.items)

    // @ts-expect-error 无默认值的布尔选项不能作为必有布尔值使用
    expectType<boolean>(options.includeTests)
    // @ts-expect-error 未声明的选项不可访问
    expectType(options.missing)
    // @ts-expect-error 终端拼写不会增加结果字段
    expectType(options.entry)

    const resolved: FinalConfig = {
      includeTests: options.includeTests ?? config.includeTests ?? false,
      retries: options.retries ?? config.retries ?? 0,
    }
    expectType<boolean>(resolved.includeTests)
    expectType<number>(resolved.retries)
    // @ts-expect-error CLI 缺省值需要完成配置合并才能作为最终配置
    const unresolved: FinalConfig = options
    return resolved
  },
})

const input: RunConfig = { argv: ['--entry=application'] }
const app = defineCommand({ commands: { run: command }, defaultCommand: 'run' })
expectType<Promise<RunResult>>(run(app, input))

// @ts-expect-error 默认命令不能扩大已注册命令键
defineCommand({ commands: { run: command }, defaultCommand: 'missing' })

// @ts-expect-error 布尔默认值不能使用字符串
option.boolean({ default: 'false' })
// @ts-expect-error 布尔开关不支持 required
option.boolean({ required: true })
// @ts-expect-error 默认值不能显式为 undefined
option.boolean({ default: undefined })

const requestedExit: ExitResult = exit(7)
expectType<number>(requestedExit.exitCode)
// @ts-expect-error 退出结果只读
requestedExit.exitCode = 1
// @ts-expect-error 退出结果只能由工厂创建
expectType<ExitResult>({ exitCode: 7 })
// @ts-expect-error 退出码必须是数值
exit('7')
const exitCommand = defineCommand({ run: async () => requestedExit })
run(exitCommand, { argv: [] }).then((result) => {
  if (result.kind === 'exit') {
    expectType<number>(result.exitCode)
    expectType<readonly string[]>(result.commandPath)
    // @ts-expect-error 退出分支没有业务值
    expectType(result.value)
  }
})

const errorOptions: CommandErrorOptions = { exitCode: 2 }
const expectedFailure = new CommandError('项目无效', errorOptions)
expectType<Error>(expectedFailure)
expectType<number>(expectedFailure.exitCode)
// @ts-expect-error 错误退出码只读
expectedFailure.exitCode = 1
// @ts-expect-error 消息必须是字符串
new CommandError(7)
// @ts-expect-error 退出码不能显式为 undefined
new CommandError('项目无效', { exitCode: undefined })
const failedCommand = defineCommand({ run: async () => { throw expectedFailure } })
run(failedCommand, { argv: [] }).then((result) => {
  if (result.kind === 'failed') {
    expectType<string>(result.message)
    expectType<number>(result.exitCode)
    expectType<readonly string[]>(result.commandPath)
    // @ts-expect-error 预期失败不是解析错误
    expectType(result.diagnostic)
  }
})
